summary: Both defects fixed and every runnable gate re-run green. FILES: src/components/viewer3d/SceneLayers.tsx (mount swap + v18b measurement comment), src/geometry/vasculature-courses.ts (new measured built-in course + one colour per vessel family + doc), src/geometry/anatomyAssets.ts (deleted the phantom LINKS entry — PLAN.md 5 E4; see DEVIATION). DEFECT 1 (colours): E1 removed variant="vessel" from the NERVE mount (SceneLayers.tsx:822-823) and E2 added it to BOTH TractTubes of the VESSEL mount (:839-840), so the 12 nerve tubes take the plain tract preset again and the 79 vessel tubes take createVesselMaterial. The material memo was read end to end (TractTube.tsx:385 default prop -> :429-431 createVesselMaterial(tract.color) -> :439 created.vertexColors = variant !== 'vessel' -> :441-443 striation normalMap only when variant !== 'vessel'), so the vertex-colour/striation decision is ALREADY shipped (commit 8d80572, v18b): a vessel tube keeps NEITHER the tract length-gradient NOR the striation map, i.e. solid crimson with no gradient — no material edit was needed and none was made. 2D side verified by execution, not assumed: a census over the merged table compares course.color (3D tube) vs taxonomy.color vs SECTION_VESSEL_PARTS color for all 41 courses and all 12 nerve courses: 41/41 and 12/12 agree, 0 mismatches. E5 closed the one real disagreement the census found (the three built-in records carried #b91c1c where their registry row, their structure record and their 2D part say #991b1b): distinct tube colours are now #991b1b (14) and #dc2626 (27), all crimson, was 39/40 before. DEFECT 2 (the blob): the brief's attribution was FALSE and was falsified by execution — a probe reproducing SceneLayers' exact predicate stack prints hasVesselCourse('vasc-lenticulostriate-arteries') = true (it is a drawing course), so that record has drawn only a tube since v17 and cannot blob. The survivor is vasc-posterior-medial-choroidal-artery: isStructureVisible true, hasVesselCourse/hasVesselCourseGroup/hasNerveCourse false, ENVELOPE/SOMATOTOPY false, and its two declared body slugs (…-l, …-r) resolve 0/2 against the 138 manifest parts, so NucleusMesh settled to the unit-sphere fallback at origin3d [14,18,-6], size3d [4,4,6], opaque-paired = the crimson translucent sphere. FIX (E3): a new BUILT_IN_VESSEL_COURSES record for that id, authored from MEASURED committed geometry (scratch probe over the shipped GLBs): ORIGIN [10.363,13.456,-16.527] = most posterior committed vertex of vasc-posterior-cerebral-artery-p2-l (residual to the nearest ctx-midbrain-surface vertex 6.583 au = 7.90 mm); MIDDLE [5.244,14.752,-12.595] = that midbrain (collicular/tectal) vertex, 0.000 au from the declared surface ctx-midbrain-surface; TERMINAL [18.832,22.802,-17.664] = the ctx-choroid-plexus-l vertex nearest the take-off (the atrial plexus/glomus), 12.664 au = 15.20 mm — a graze, as a choroidal artery ends ON the plexus. Chord arc 23.18 au = 27.8 mm (the gate recomputes and prints 27.8 independently). surface/basis/elementIds/anchorNote/surfaceNote state exactly what is claimed: basis documented-course because the archive element pair FJ1727/FJ1727M (880 faces, FMA 50630) names the artery but was never registered, meshed or baked, so no baked body is claimed. SWEEP (asked for): reproducing the structure pass over every record and resolving EVERY mounted slug against the manifest gives, before the fix, 65 records with some uncommitted slug of which exactly 1 is vasculature (vasc-posterior-medial-choroidal-artery) and, after the fix, 64 of which 0 are vasculature — the remaining 64 are the documented v1 placeholder family (ctx-* functional areas, nuc-subiculum, surf-cn*-exit, …) whose ellipsoid IS their authored body, so no second blob is waiting to be found. The nine lenticulostriate records stay courses (vessel-render prints lenticulostriate records 9, suppressed 9) and still draw their tubes. DEVIATION, disclosed and required: the evidence contract's vessel-render exit 0 is UNSATISFIABLE by the two in-scope files alone — with the course added but anatomyAssets.ts:317 still declaring vasc-posterior-medial-choroidal-artery-{l,r}, the gate's own model (bakedBody = LINKS present) produces 'FAIL no vessel renders both a baked body and a course tube — vasc-posterior-medial-choroidal-artery', 74/75 (recorded run); so PLAN.md 5 E4 was applied (the phantom entry deleted, replaced by a comment stating the LINKS-XOR-course invariant and why both v8 bodyless vessel records are absent) and the gate then reads 75/75, blobs 0, and the record's row reads 'none | yes | no | tube only'. anatomyAssets.ts is named by PLAN.md for exactly this suppression/model change and belongs to no task in this 3-task run. Chrome claims (verify:acceptance / verify:audit / that the scene PAINTS it) are orchestrator-only and are NOT claimed here. HANDOFFS outside my write scope (both in PLAN.md): (a) TractTube.tsx:350 lerps every tube's opacity toward 1 (TractTube.tsx:350, registry entry :461-467 has no idle-opacity term) while committed arteries are pinned at KIND_OPACITY.vessel = 0.5 (NucleusMesh.tsx:186-187) — after this fix the vessel tubes will be the most solid red objects in the scene; PLAN 5 E6 is a one-field + one-line change. (b) scripts/verify/vessel-render.mjs:648 still models a baked body as 'has a LINKS entry', the exact blindness that hid this blob (the manifest check that closes it, and the mount-regex re-point at :601-602 which now matches the NERVE block, are PLAN 5 E7/E8).
